I’m unable to determine the SMILES string without any structural information about the compound. Could you please provide any of the following details so I can identify the molecule and return its SMILES representation?

- Molecular formula  
- A description of the functional groups or connectivity (e.g., “a benzene ring with a para‑nitro substituent”)  
- Spectral data (¹H NMR, ¹³C NMR, IR, MS)  
- Any other identifying information (e.g., common name, CAS number)  

With that information I can generate the correct SMILES while keeping the use of costly analyses to a minimum.
